cells.reason: State Anti-Eviction Act governs just-cause eviction statewide. The provided documents don't show whether Newark has a separate local just-cause ordinance.
Security deposits are governed by the state Security Deposit Law. The documents show no Newark-specific deposit ordinance.
cells.quoted_span: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).

cells.reason: Application fees are capped by the state law, P.L.2025, c.405. The documents show no Newark local application-fee ordinance.
cells.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.

No Newark local algorithmic rent-setting ordinance appears in the documents. The state FAIR Act covers this category and bars municipalities from enacting conflicting ordinances.
cells.quoted_span: A municipality shall be prohibited from enacting an ordinance that conflicts with this act.
